title: Synthetic Data Generation using CTGAN
summary: A Flask-based web application built for the PWC Cyber Hackathon 2024 that generates privacy-compliant synthetic employee and payment-card (PCI) test data for financial institutions, exportable as CSV, Excel, JSON, or Word. It uses SDV's HMASynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer (via sdv.multi_table and sdv.single_table) with Metadata objects to fit and sample the synthetic datasets that the API serves.
evidence: api.py:7-11: from sdv.multi_table import HMASynthesizer; from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer; synthesizer.fit(data); synthesizer.sample(scale=1)
